C1547.title: Academic Research Reveals NFT Royalty Bypass Mechanism
C1547.summary: An ACM CCS 2022 paper titled 'Understanding security issues in the NFT ecosystem' reveals that sellers can completely bypass NFT marketplace protocols through over-the-counter (OTC) deals, avoiding royalty payments to creators.
